result.instructions: Tools for SavvyCal, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SavvyCal data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run savvycal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run savvycal_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run savvycal_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. savvycal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: savvycal_list_links
tools.title: List links
tools.description: List the authenticated user's scheduling links (paginated). SavvyCal REST: GET /links.

tools.name: savvycal_get_link
tools.title: Get link
tools.description: Get a single scheduling link by id. SavvyCal REST: GET /links/{id}.

tools.name: savvycal_get_link_slots
tools.title: Get link slots
tools.description: Get available booking time slots for a scheduling link. Returns slots with start_at/end_at/duration/rank. SavvyCal REST: GET /links/{id}/slots.

duration.description: Slot duration in minutes to request (→ query param duration).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the slots, e.g. America/New_York (→ query param time_zone).

tools.name: savvycal_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List booked events/meetings (paginated). SavvyCal REST: GET /events.

tools.name: savvycal_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: Get a single booked event/meeting by id. SavvyCal REST: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: savvycal_toggle_link
tools.title: Toggle link
tools.description: Toggle a scheduling link between active and disabled (changes whether the public booking page accepts bookings). SavvyCal REST: POST /links/{id}/toggle.

id.description: The scheduling link id to toggle.

tools.name: savvycal_duplicate_link
tools.title: Duplicate link
tools.description: Create a copy of an existing scheduling link. SavvyCal REST: POST /links/{id}/duplicate.

id.description: The scheduling link id to duplicate.

tools.name: savvycal_cancel_event
tools.title: Cancel event
tools.description: Cancel a booked event/meeting. This notifies attendees and frees the slot. SavvyCal REST: DELETE /events/{id}.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason (→ request body { reason }).
